sloka: सो ऽहं वनमिदं दुर्गं मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् ।तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टो ऽस्मि समीपे सरसः शुभे ।। ७.७८.८ ॥
transliteration: so 'haṁ vanamidaṁ durgaṁ mṛgapakṣivivarjitam ।tapaścartuṁ praviṣṭo 'smi samīpe sarasaḥ śubhe ।। 7.78.8 ॥

translations.english: I entered this inaccessible forest, devoid of deer and birds, to perform penance near an auspicious lake.
